## Episode Thesis

This VG/E24 personal-finance episode asks whether investors should buy Norwegian equity funds now that Oslo Børs is up more than 20% in 2026. The hosts note that Oslo Børs has lagged global indices over 10–20 years because it is heavy in oil and finance and light in tech. Its low tech weighting could act as a hedge if there is an AI bubble, and good Norwegian active managers have historically beaten the index. The guest's top fund picks are SpareBank 1 Norge Verdi, Holberg Norge, Nordea Norge Verdi, Heimdal Utbytte and, for higher risk, DNB SMB. He suggests keeping Norway to about 10% of a portfolio. No individual stocks get a buy or sell call.
